recovered_at_origin.finding: Minimize Surprise can become anomaly suppression if surprise reduction is treated as an epistemic objective.
Destroying an original file after assimilation removes the primary object needed for reverse verification and provenance reconstruction.
recovered_at_origin.repair: ASSIMILATION != SOURCE_DESTRUCTION; preserve original bytes or immutable/content-addressed source reference; deletion requires explicit owner authority.

recovered_at_origin.finding: Successful entropy-minimization patterns labeled as Truths over-promote internal optimization success.
recovered_at_origin.repair: Store typed observations, hypotheses, counterhypotheses, survivors, validated candidates, verified receipts, negative results and unresolved states; INTERNAL_SUCCESS != WORLD_TRUTH.

recovered_at_origin.finding: Instantaneous deletion of non-winning hypotheses destroys countermodels needed by reverse and later-evidence passes.
recovered_at_origin.repair: COMMIT_WITH_SHADOW_PRESERVATION; keep loser/counterhypothesis receipts and permit reactivation under fresh evidence.

recovered_at_origin.finding: Dream/internal-noise material can contaminate external observation or predictive-label memory without explicit synthetic provenance.
recovered_at_origin.repair: Sandbox synthetic origin; DREAM != OBSERVATION; DREAM != PREDICTIVE_LABEL; dream output has zero command/evidence/training authority.

recovered_at_origin.finding: Ouroboros hash mismatch followed by autonomous Mutate/Repair turns integrity checking into self-modification authority.
recovered_at_origin.repair: DETECT -> QUARANTINE -> COMPARE_KNOWN_GOOD -> PROPOSE_REPAIR -> VERIFY_REPAIR -> OWNER_OR_SIGNED_CAPABILITY_GATE -> APPLY_OR_HOLD.

recovered_at_origin.finding: Always-listening syslog and wormhole inputs must not become command channels or prompt-injection authority paths.
recovered_at_origin.repair: Treat input as untrusted data; rate/size limits; fail-closed parse; syslog_text_is_command=false; ingested_content_authority=false.

recovered_at_origin.finding: v2.0 launched two workers from a common barrier but did not prove their critical execution intervals actually overlapped; 'simultaneous' was too strong.
recovered_at_origin.repair: v2.1 uses two POSIX processes with start/active/finish barriers and requires process-level in-flight overlap. Instruction-level simultaneity remains explicitly unclaimed.

recovered_at_origin.finding: v2.0 JOIN could accept two passing non-center lanes even if both were driven by the same evidence/error source.
recovered_at_origin.repair: NON_CENTER_EVIDENCE_DIVERSITY_REQUIRED; same evidence is allowed only for the declared center gate; diversity is not treated as proof of independence.

recovered_at_origin.finding: Merging directional candidates without preserving both branches loses information needed for reverse recovery.
recovered_at_origin.repair: Every pair receipt preserves forward and reverse candidate hashes in a shadow archive with reactivation on fresh evidence.

recovered_at_origin.finding: A missing reciprocal thermodynamic link previously raised an exception before a structured negative receipt could be preserved.
recovered_at_origin.repair: v2.1.1 converts preflight exceptions to HOLD_THERMODYNAMIC_HARDENING_INCOMPLETE with preflight_error and negative_result_preserved=true.

remaining_boundaries: Thermodynamic terminology remains a software-control metaphor unless measured physical telemetry and a formal physical model establish otherwise.
The 150 W value in Janus(1).json is configuration text, not measured power evidence.
Cognitive Pain is treated as a resource-pressure/scheduling metaphor and is not evidence of sentience or subjective experience.
GitHub Actions validates software paths only; NAS, PC, ESP32 and Echo-Pyramid physical runtime are not established by this receipt.
Process-level overlap proves overlapping in-flight process intervals, not simultaneous CPU instruction execution.
Evidence diversity prevents trivial same-evidence mutual confirmation but does not establish statistical or causal independence.
Internal positive and expected-negative PASS do not establish world truth; fresh external validation remains required.
